skills.name: Find LCD / Convert Denominators
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two unlike-denominator fractions and rewrite both as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract Numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator to obtain the fractional difference.

skills.name: Subtract Whole Parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of two mixed numbers (or a mixed number and a whole number) independently of the fraction parts.

skills.name: Borrow Across Whole/Fraction
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction yields a negative value, regroup one unit from the whole part as denominator/denominator and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to its lowest-terms equivalent by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Normalize Improper Mixed Number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fraction part is itself improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form by regrouping the excess into the whole part before subtracting.
